comparisonMethod.capture: Floot current full read_files with diagnostics off, limit 3000; all headers and consecutive numbered lines verified complete.
comparisonMethod.raw: Strip only the cat-n numeric prefix. Preserve every code character and internal blank line. Record hashes for the joined rendered lines and for those lines plus one final LF.
comparisonMethod.canonical: For the content-equivalence comparison only, collapse terminal LF characters to one final LF. All formatting variants are reported separately; no other whitespace is normalized.
comparisonMethod.limitation: read_files is a line-rendered source view, not a byte-download API. Exact terminal-newline counts cannot be proven from the view when its rendering omits them; this report does not mislabel normalized matches as byte-identical.

source_retention: Source is retained in the named Floot checkpoint. This committed receipt contains paths, versions, comparisons and hashes; it does not duplicate the source archive.

backend_money_source_followup.scope: Separate Git backend source repair. It is not part of the 102 Floot files or this Floot source-content comparison.

documentation_checkpoint.scope: Documentation-only successor; no code change or publication.
